neopure.title: NEAPURE Launches Next-Gen Water Purifier Series
neopure.imageAlt: Fresh water being poured into a clear glass
neopure.summary: A new range of under-sink and countertop purifiers brings multi-stage filtration, smart filter alerts and lower running costs to homes across Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh.

body.p1: NeaPure has introduced its next-generation purifier series, designed for the water conditions of the region. Each unit combines sediment, carbon and reverse-osmosis stages with a mineral balance cartridge, so families get water that is clean, safe and pleasant to drink.
body.p2: The new series connects to the NEAMAT CARE platform. Filter life is tracked automatically, customers receive a reminder before a change is due, and a verified technician can be booked in a few taps — turning water care into a simple, scheduled routine.
body.p3: The series is rolling out first in Riyadh and Dhaka through NeaPure's dealer network, with installation, testing and a service warranty included on every purchase.

neopure.quote: Clean water should never be an afterthought. This series makes it effortless to keep every glass safe.

booleanforce.title: BooleanForce Wins Digital Innovation Award
booleanforce.imageAlt: A gold trophy held up in celebration
booleanforce.summary: BooleanForce has been recognised for its work on digital platforms that connect customers, field teams and operations across the NEAMAT GLOBAL group.

body.p1: BooleanForce, the group's IT and digital technology company, has received a digital innovation award for the platforms it builds for businesses in Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh.
body.p2: The award highlights BooleanForce's approach: product thinking, strong engineering and design that is tested with real users. Its team builds the technology behind NEAMAT CARE and PropertyOS, alongside projects for external clients.
body.p3: The recognition reflects the group's investment in technology talent in Dhaka and its ambition to export digital solutions across the region.

booleanforce.quote: We build technology that people actually use every day. This award belongs to our whole team.

neamatcare.title: NEAMAT CARE Opens New Service Center in Riyadh
neamatcare.imageAlt: A technician repairing an air-conditioning unit in a service workshop
neamatcare.summary: A new service center in Riyadh brings faster response times, a parts store and a training workshop for NEAMAT CARE technicians.

body.p1: NEAMAT CARE has opened a new service center in Riyadh to support its growing base of home, property and facility customers in the city.
body.p2: The center houses a dispatch team, a spare-parts store and a hands-on training workshop where technicians are certified on air-conditioning, electrical, plumbing and water-purifier work before they visit customers.
body.p3: With technicians based closer to the neighbourhoods they serve, customers can expect shorter wait times and more same-day appointments — all booked and tracked through the NEAMAT CARE platform.

neamatcare.quote: Every visit should feel reliable. A strong service center is how we make that promise real.

propertyos.title: PropertyOS and Leading Partners Sign Strategic Deal
propertyos.summary: PropertyOS has signed a strategic agreement to bring digital property and facility management to a portfolio of residential and commercial buildings.

body.p1: PropertyOS, the group's property-management software company, has signed a strategic partnership to digitise the operations of a portfolio of residential and commercial buildings.
body.p2: Owners and managers will use PropertyOS to handle leases, rent collection, maintenance requests and tenant communication in one place, with maintenance jobs routed directly to NEAMAT CARE technicians.
body.p3: The partnership is a milestone for PropertyOS as it scales beyond its first customers and builds a connected ecosystem with the other NEAMAT GLOBAL companies.

propertyos.quote: Great buildings deserve great operations. Together we are making property management simpler for everyone.

faq.title: Answers, by topic
faq.description: Choose a topic to see the questions we're asked most often.

q1.a: NEAMAT GLOBAL is a diversified group of four companies — NeaPure (water technology), PropertyOS (property management software), BooleanForce (IT and digital technology) and NEAMAT CARE (home, facility and maintenance services).

q2.a: Our head office is in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and our operations hub is in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We are planning further growth across the Gulf and the wider region.

q3.q: How can my company partner with you?
q3.a: Use the Contact page and choose “Partnerships & business”. Our partnerships team will review your message and reply within two working days.

q4.q: How do I contact the media team?
q4.a: Journalists can choose “Media & press” on the Contact form or email our media team directly.

q1.q: Which services does NEAMAT CARE offer?
q1.a: NEAMAT CARE covers water purifier care, air-conditioning and appliances, electrical work, plumbing, deep cleaning, pest control, and planned maintenance for properties and facilities.

q2.a: Yes. Every technician is identity-checked, trained and certified for the services they provide before they can accept jobs.

q3.q: Is there a warranty on the work?
q3.a: Every completed job is covered by the NEAMAT CARE service warranty. If something isn't right, book a follow-up visit from your service history.

q4.q: Do you serve businesses and buildings?
q4.a: Yes. PropertyCare and FacilityCare plans cover landlords, residential buildings, offices, retail and public facilities, with scheduled visits and reporting.

q1.q: How do I book a service?
q1.a: Book on neamatcare.com: choose the service, add your address and pick a time slot. You'll receive a confirmation with your technician's details.

q2.a: Yes. You can reschedule or cancel from your booking at no cost up to a few hours before the appointment.

q3.a: You'll see the price before you confirm. Payment is collected when the job is completed, and online payment options are being added.

q4.a: Yes. A digital invoice is saved to your service history after every completed job.

q1.q: What personal data do you collect?
q1.a: Only what we need to provide our services — such as your name, contact details, address and service history. Our Privacy Policy explains this in full.

q2.a: No. We never sell personal data. We share it only with the people needed to deliver your service, such as the assigned technician.

q3.q: How do I update or delete my information?
q3.a: Contact our support team and we'll update or delete your data, subject to any records we're legally required to keep.

q4.a: Our websites support English and Arabic, and the NEAMAT CARE platform also supports Bangla.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your personal information.
PrivacyPage.intro: NEAMAT GLOBAL and its companies — NeaPure, PropertyOS, BooleanForce and NEAMAT CARE — respect your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it and the choices you have.

scope.title: Who this policy covers
body: This policy applies to neamatglobal.com and to the websites, platforms and services of the NEAMAT GLOBAL companies, unless a service has its own privacy notice.
NEAMAT GLOBAL is the controller of the personal data described here. Where a group company provides a service to you directly, that company is also responsible for your data.

collect.title: Information we collect
body: Information you give us, such as your name, email address, phone number, address, company and the details of your enquiry, booking or job application.
Information created when you use our services, such as service history, invoices and communication with our teams.
Technical information, such as your device type, browser, approximate location and how you use our websites, collected through cookies and similar technologies.

use.title: How we use your information
body: To respond to enquiries, provide and improve our services, schedule and complete service visits, process payments and provide customer support.
To send service messages and, where you have agreed, news about our companies. You can unsubscribe from marketing at any time.
To keep our services secure, prevent fraud and meet our legal obligations.

share.title: How we share information
body: We share personal data within the NEAMAT GLOBAL group only where it is needed to provide the service you asked for — for example, with a NEAMAT CARE technician assigned to your booking.
We use trusted service providers for hosting, communication and payments, under contracts that protect your data. We do not sell personal data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
body: We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purposes described here, or as required by law. Service and invoice records may be kept for accounting and warranty purposes.

rights.title: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to withdraw consent.
To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before responding.

security.title: How we protect your data
body: We use technical and organisational measures — including encryption, access controls and staff training — to protect personal data against loss, misuse and unauthorised access.

cookies.title: Cookies
body: We use essential cookies to make our websites work and, with your consent where required, analytics cookies to understand how they are used. You can control cookies in your browser settings.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised, and significant changes will be highlighted on our website.
